objective: Execute actual CI and download at least one authentic officially hosted political dataset with bytes/hashes; keep fallback STOP_R5 if direct access fails; update scope-index based on evidence
evidence_preexposure: C01 native CI pass for prior BR20K commit seen before this prereg, retrospectively reported. Other direct official fetches not yet run. Source URLs public and the dataset examples are known; no scientific confirmatory field preregistration.
testable_units: independent reproducible native test/log or HTTPS capture; separate engineering, documentary and substantive field validity
rules: no fake hashes, official bytes or authenticated first_public_at
binary SHA only proves integrity of downloaded bytes, not semantics/license/time published
only show anonymized raw schemas; no user-facing roster names
version progress based on auditable changes, preserve prior frozen scope and old snapshot
j=STOP_R5 for blocked field tests, not pass
n1/2/3 scientific and VSDS / CT2 remain independent
